population_contract.existing_owner: Existing host ResourceLedger, TierLedger and claim owners through the sole guard implementer; descriptor/tier owner supplies physical and member authority; supervisor/worker-offer owner supplies host/offer evidence. floor_status discovery is diagnostic, not closure authority.
population_contract.membership_and_version: Require a reviewer-readable versioned authoritative snapshot enumerating every writer, allowance kind, ledger root, private namespace, host/tier/claim owner, destination variant and physical backing key. Bind snapshot digest/epoch and effective interval to mapping and allowance snapshots; include enrollment/removal authority and fencing of obsolete writers. A binding members array and census are only declarations. Closing a version requires proof no other writers or acquisitions can enter outside that version; unknown population HOLD.
population_contract.private_and_committed: Include private begin_acquire handles before claim commit, committed action holders, coordinator operation holders, transfers, staged residence, retained source windows and inaccessible/orphaned records. held_keys omits private acquisitions; held/held_keys tolerate missing/unreadable observations and cannot certify completeness or liveness. Do not use an empty scan to assign zero allowance.
population_contract.locking_and_recovery: Specify existing-owner lock order and atomic acquisition/census/publication boundary with grants-since-sample, private-to-committed moves and fenced transfer epochs. Include failed commit/rollback, stale lease, crash, reboot, lost writer, partial release and orphan recovery. Existing host/tier/claim owners must retain conservative charges until reconciled; operation lease reaping alone is not evidence payload/residue disappeared. Mapping or population version changes require revalidation and a fresh coherent sample before admission.
population_contract.partial_or_unreadable: Missing/unreadable ledger, stale member, uncertain token visibility, conflicting owner, inaccessible record or partial snapshot means HOLD, not silently zero. Require explicit bounded reconciliation and owner-attributed recovery evidence before reopening. floor_status unbound-ledger scans can skip unreadable directories and cannot prove a closed world.
population_contract.authenticated_nfs_mapping: Descriptor/tier owner must supply authenticated, versioned client mount/export/namespace to server backing filesystem or dataset and shared physical capacity key mapping, with server authority, export aliases, validity and remount/failover/re-export invalidation. Bind observed client descriptor/mount generation to that authority and server capacity sample. NFS addr= matching against server_addresses is conservative routing only, not authenticated export mapping. Neither hostname nor server IP proves backing FSID; uncertain mapping HOLD. ZFS datasets sharing pool capacity require both dataset constraints and shared backing aggregation, never independent spend of the same free pool.

domain_rules.application: Every domain below inherits population_contract and accounting. Entries are obligations for the parent repair, not deployed certifications. Shared paths may alias or split across filesystems; resolve using actual configured destinations and authoritative descriptors, not these category names.
domain_rules.freshness: Require effective mapping/population/allowance versions, sample capture identity and time, bounded age and coherent acquisition ordering. Timestamp or PID alone is insufficient. Revalidate after mount, boot, process, configuration, tier, lease or ownership changes. Keep all unobserved grants conservatively charged; unknown freshness HOLD.
domain_rules.aliasing: Deduplicate physical capacity samples by authenticated backing key, but sum distinct simultaneous obligations on that key. Different categories or different paths are not inherently different disks. Do not deduplicate source/destination bytes merely because their filesystem aliases. A single reservation may be counted once only with uniquely proven ownership and coverage; otherwise HOLD rather than guess.
domain_rules.bounds: Every bound must be finite, owner-approved and cover maximum simultaneous live, private, committed, retry and failure-residue growth including metadata, control records, allocation expansion and logs. Retention policy is not an active-write ceiling; cleanup intent or token return does not prove freed bytes. No complete deployment bounds were supplied.

accounting.aggregate_rule: For every actually used physical capacity domain require fresh free_bytes >= ceil(size_bytes/20) + aggregate charges, with existing inode protections retained. Compute ceil by integer arithmetic; convert each existing reservation unit conservatively to bytes and charge its complete upper bound, plus unobserved grants/proposed demand, once under a uniquely proven reservation identity. Aggregate all existing host/tier/claim obligations sharing backing capacity; also respect subordinate dataset constraints. Conservative double pressure for already resident bytes is intentional absent qualified credits, not verified exact materialization accounting.
accounting.same_owner_same_filesystem_evidence: Default is no subtraction. Any future credit requires existing allowance owner to attest bounded materialization belonging to that exact reservation and same physical backing filesystem, with authenticated mapping/version and causal sample inclusion. File size, copy-done receipt, path existence, timestamp, host label or another owner's reservation is insufficient; sparse/compressed/shared allocations must not be assumed physically materialized.
accounting.credit_identity_and_cap: Bind credit to unique reservation lineage, owner, acquisition/transfer epoch, physical key, materialization extent/incarnation and capacity sample identity/version. Cap total consumed credit by both proven allocation reflected in that sample and remaining reservation charge; charge cannot be negative. Existing owner must enforce a single-use credit disposition across all readers and aliases, not a parallel credit ledger here.
accounting.sample_and_credit_ordering: Materialization must be causally reflected in the sample used for the subtraction: owner records completed physical allocation before a sample causally observing it, then binds credit to that sample and the coherent reservation snapshot. Earlier sample free space still includes those bytes and receives ZERO credit, even if later file evidence exists. Later samples require revalidation of allocation identity, persistence, reservation and version; never carry a free-floating credit forward. Sample expiry, remount or uncertain observation means zero credit or HOLD if allowances/mapping are unknown.
accounting.transfer_rule: Private-to-committed claim commit renames custody, not a new reservation or fresh credit. Transfer must atomically fence old owner/epoch and move charge with any already-consumed credit disposition under existing-owner locks. If destination is a different filesystem, source charge/residence persists until its release authority, while full destination/copy charge is acquired before writing. Credit cannot appear on both sides or be replayed after retry. On incomplete transfer retain conservative coverage and HOLD new dependent admission until reconciled.
accounting.release_rule: Only existing owner release/recovery authority retires a reservation. Retire credit at the same lineage/epoch transition; do not subtract it again from another holder or interpret returned tokens as proof bytes vanished. Persisting stage/spool/log residue must be represented by an existing owner's complete bound before releasing its covering obligation. ACK, copy completion, origin commit and unlink authority are distinct; preserve produced_spool protocol.
accounting.partial_failure_rule: Crashes between acquire, write, sample, commit, transfer or release must recover exactly one fenced custody lineage. Uncertain materialization receives zero credit; lost/unreadable or conflicting allowance state HOLD. Retry creates a new attempt but cannot reuse old credit identity; old partial/resident bytes remain covered until owner-proven reconciliation. No sample may omit private acquisitions or grants made after its allowance census.
accounting.complete_bound_inclusions: Finite bounds must include payloads plus source-bank/Git/extraction/generated expansion, allocation/metadata/control records, queue events, active and retained logs, temp copies, stage partial/retry residue, local spool/source and destination coexistence, concurrent scratch, failed attempts and recovery residue. Existing positive ROOT/MAX reservations remain separately rounded; no arbitrary reduction to make admission pass.
accounting.operation_vs_action_custody: operationP denotes committed coordinator prepublication custody conceptually, not a new API: existing filesystem_floor.operation has operation-* holders and lease ownership. It must cover package preparation and publication before normal actionK exists, without a bootstrap exemption. Normal actionK custody is existing pool private begin_acquire then commit_acquire(action_key) ownership and action/attempt lifecycle. Neither automatically covers the other: acquire/commit destination custody before source operation releases, prove nonduplicated transfer coverage and retain old charge/residue if handoff fails. write_window's CAS growth allocation and exit before waiter are source facts, not proof of complete per-filesystem handoff.
